gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with histologically confirmed glioblastoma per 2021 WHO classification at first progression according to RANO criteria.

candidate_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] ARM 1: Fractionating Lomustine: Patients will be treated in escalating cohorts of 6 patients with 10 µg/kg L19TNF on Days 1, 3 and 5

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Safety and Efficacy of Different Administration Sequences of L19TNF With Lomustine in Glioblastoma at First Progression

role_evidence.quote: [DRUG] Onfekafusp alfa (other names: L19TNF): Patients will be treated with 10 µg/kg L19TNF on Days 1, 3 and 5, and on Days 22, 24 and 26

agents.drug_class_hint: antibody-cytokine fusion protein (L19 antibody fused to TNF)

role_evidence.quote: to explore two different administration schedules of lomustine for the combination with L19TNF (ARM 1 and ARM 2)

source_quote.quote: MGMT promotor methylation status known or tumor tissue for analysis available.

coder_notes: Lomustine schedule/dose differs between arms and is the stated question, so rule 6 (established_therapy_experiment) applies before C3. MGMT: only requires that status be known or tissue available, not a particular status, so coded as non-selecting (exploratory_correlative) rather than eligibility.
